creation_events.title: How does an octopus find food in the dark?
creation_events.message: Red octopuses followed chemical trails in dark laboratory flumes; 31 of 41 successful feeding approaches came from inside an estimated plume, repeated events from five males, not 41 animals. Suckers may guide search; sensory mechanism not isolated. Exact approved MP4 verified on both networks for Friday 4 December 2026 10:00 Europe/Vienna. Scheduled, not published.
